dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: This is the Yanshang Teahouse.

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: The new owner says that all who approach are guests, so you might as well head up for some tea.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're under new ownership?

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: The previous owner sold this property due to debt problems.

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: The new owner made some adjustments to how we operate after taking over...

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: ...But not that you'd understand, anyway. Just treat this place like any other "teahouse." Heh.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not going to "escort" me away?

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: No idea what you're talking about. Of course not.

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: Our new owner also hopes that more people will come to drink tea... As long as they behave, drink tea, and chat, they are welcome here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: It's a rare thing to lose... By the way, do you want to go upstairs?

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: Don't forget, I am Yanshang Teahouse's hostess. Playing cards is second nature to me...

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: This is the Yanshang Teahouse.

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: Now that you're here, are you mentally prepared? Did you bring enough money?

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: It sounds like the tea here must be quite expensive.

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: Who said that a teahouse must only sell tea?

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: Someone stupid like you shouldn't be out making a mess of our city. Your time would be better spent listening to an opera or sitting in a restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: There're some places you don't belong, and you're most certainly not needed around here.

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: If you don't leave, I will have to ask security to "escort" you away.

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: No, thank you. Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: Oh, so you do have some manners...

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: I'll return the courtesy by not calling our security. Good day.
